mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no, u.username, u.img_url, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM follow_info f WHERE f.user_no = #{userNo} AND f.to_user_no = u.user_no) AS follow FROM recent_user ru LEFT JOIN user u ON ru.to_user_no = u.user_no WHERE ru.user_no = #{userNo} AND u.user_no != #{userNo} ORDER BY ru.view_time DESC LIMIT 7
